assertion.value: This study used only publicly available, de-identified datasets from PhysioNet. The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 dataset is fully de-identified and publicly accessible under the PhysioNet credentialed data use requirements. The MIMIC-IV v3.1 database is a de-identified clinical dataset released under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Safe Harbor provision. Access to MIMIC-IV requires completion of human-subjects training and agreement to the data use license; therefore, no institutional review board (IRB) approval or informed consent was required for this secondary analysis.
